notes: kb/Work PB369, PB5080, PB5139. Rule text (cite.py --check "§2023:14.9.16.3 SR3" "the report description entry in which data-name-1 is specified" -> OK). The rule begins at 2002 (§2002:14.8.15.2 SR3, §2014:14.9.15.2 SR3; each checked with cite.py --check), so the row's editions are 2002, 2014 and 2023. Both halves hold there. The RD half by construction: only a GLOBAL report of a container is visible to a contained program (DataBinder.VisibleReports), so a group of a non-GLOBAL one does not resolve and the GENERATE is refused COBOL1757 (negative/pb369-contained-generate-non-global-report). The FD half: RejectContainedReportFile, the one check the four verb rules share, refuses a GLOBAL report whose FD is not GLOBAL with COBOL2392, citing the rule of the edition compiled. 1985 has no FD half: a global name may be referenced from a contained program without describing it again (§1985:X.4.6.4 GR2), so --std 85 accepts the GENERATE (kb/Work PB5080). retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Reports.cs#InheritGlobalReport (kb/Work PB2357 split DataBinder.Reports.cs: the same code, unchanged, now lives in ReportSectionBinder.cs (the binder), ReportModel.cs (the model types) and ReportScope.cs (the visible-report lookups)) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/ReportSectionBinder.cs#InheritGlobalReport (listing step 6b slice 5, kb/Work PB5932, moved the report-section names and their walks into the symbol table; the row cites src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/SymbolTable/SymbolTable.Reports.cs#InheritReport)
